India food regulator issues notices to energy drink brands for misleading claims

India's Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued notices to several energy drink brands, including Red Bull and PepsiCo, for alleged misbranding and misleading claims. The notices were reportedly served over issues related to product labeling and content. This action by the food regulator highlights scrutiny over the marketing and composition of popular energy drinks in the Indian market.
